mechanism_narrative: A lower current federal funds rate directly reduces the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS against 5-day returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A current unemployment rate above 4.2% signals labor market weakness that reduces corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.2, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate above 4.1% and decline in employment below 158,500 thousand persons signals a weakening labor market that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where UNRATE > 4.1 and PAYEMS < 158500, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the joint Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 310), a higher current CPIAUCSL rate compresses real corporate profits and triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 310), the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A current housing starts level below 1,350 thousand units indicates weak consumer demand for housing, reducing overall economic activity and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1350, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A current industrial production level below 102.5 indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, signaling economic slowdown and reduced corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 102.5, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher recent quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates strong economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for GDPC1 against 60-day returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts below 1,350 thousand units and industrial production below 102.5 signals a broad economic slowdown across both consumer and manufacturing sectors, reducing corporate profit growth and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where HOUST < 1350 and INDPRO < 102.5, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the joint Rank IC is below 0.03.
